design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Rate control: no increase in peak discharge over existing for 2-, 10-, and 100-year 24-hour events (NRCS MN MSE 3 distribution). Water quality: 70% TSS removal from a 1.25-inch storm event, plus receiving-water-specific TP reductions (Table 4-1). Volume control: capture and retain 1.1 inches of runoff from new and fully reconstructed impervious (new/redevelopment); linear projects retain the larger of 0.55 inches from new/reconstructed impervious or 1.1 inches from net impervious increase; drawdown ≤48 hours.

extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipal guide adopts MPCA Minnesota Stormwater Manual as the approved BMP design manual while stating city-specific rate, volume, and water-quality standards. Design storm depths in Table 4-3 are NOAA Atlas 14 values for HydroCAD/XP-SWMM. Pipeline excerpt repair removed 1 unlocated citation(s).

design_parameters.enrich_notes: City ordinance standards in excerpts: 70% TSS from a 1.25-inch storm; volume retention 1.1 inches (new/redev) or larger of 0.55/1.1 inches (linear). Infiltration restricted where native rate exceeds 8.3 in/hr unless amended below 8.3 in/hr; minimum 3 ft separation to seasonally saturated soils/bedrock. BMP sizing/design details refer to MPCA Minnesota Stormwater Manual; Table 4-8 design infiltration rates not included in corpus. Rain garden O&M triggers action if standing water remains 72 hours after a storm (maintenance, not a stated design drawdown standard in excerpts).
